prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Stable Diffusion+ GPT3 customization and deployment
I'm looking for an expert in GPT-3 and Stable Diffusion to build a relationship with and help me develop / integrate the tech into a couple different projects long term, starting witth 1. Looking to integrate this tech into an existing brand.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open by restating the client's specific problem in one sentence.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Keep it under 150 words.
- End with one specific question about the job.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
You want to integrate GPT-3 and Stable Diffusion into an existing brand and build a long-term technical relationship to support that and future projects.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience working with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I can help you plan, build, and deploy the integration in a way that fits your brand and scales cleanly as the work expands. I’m comfortable handling both the application layer and the product integration details needed to make the tech practical and maintainable.

If you’d like, I can help map the best approach for the first project and set up the foundation for the next ones as well. What’s the first brand experience or workflow you want GPT-3 and Stable Diffusion to power?
